scripts.start: (npx --yes playwright install chromium 2>&1 | grep -vE 'is already installed|skipping' || true) && node --unhandled-rejections=warn server.js
scripts.start:supervised: until node --unhandled-rejections=warn server.js; do echo '[supervisor] backend exited, restarting in 2s'; sleep 2; done
scripts.build: npm install && npx --yes playwright install chromium --with-deps
scripts.postinstall: npx --yes playwright install chromium || echo 'WARN: playwright postinstall failed — start script will retry'
